summary: Iter96 B2B Corporate Wellness Onboarding backend tested end-to-end. All 20 iter96 tests (12 live API + 8 static/frontend guards) PASS and the full iter95 regression suite (41 tests across negotiation E2E, trainer detail / A-B, batch all) PASS. Public ingress also verified for /api/corporate/landing/{slug} (400 bad / 404 unknown) and auth-gated endpoints (403 unauth).
critical_code_review_comments: corporate_routes.py is 480 lines — within healthy limits; cleanly split into create/list/update/credit/invite/redeem/employee/usage/me/landing sections.
Public landing endpoint correctly strips creditPoolCents, adminUserIds, contactEmail before returning — verified by test_public_landing_returns_safe_fields.
Slug validation uses Pydantic regex (a-z0-9-, 3-40 chars); duplicate slug yields 409, malformed yields 422 — both verified.
Credit-pool top-up correctly rejects negative amounts via Pydantic constraint (422) and writes ledger row.
Double-redeem of the same invite by the same trainee returns 409 already-enrolled — verified by test_redeem_happy_path_and_exhausted (which also cleans prior memberships first, good fixture hygiene).
All endpoints exclude MongoDB _id from responses via _serialize_* helpers — no ObjectId leakage observed.
Auth/role gating works: list_companies = platform admin only (403 for trainee), get_company forbidden for outsiders, /me/company requires auth (403 without token from public ingress).

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates an ephemeral ACME-{hex} company via module-scope fixture; redeem test cleans trainee memberships before re-running so the suite is idempotent. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter96 corporate endpoints (12 endpoints under /api/corporate/*) are fully wired and stable. The test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration96_corporate.py is the canonical regression guard — it self-cleans the trainee membership on each run. Stripe key in this pod is intentionally expired (do not flag); SendGrid + Instagram remain mocked per handoff. Next agent: pick up frontend Playwright coverage for /corporate/signup, /redeem, /dashboard, and /c/[slug] (data-testids already in place: corp-redeem-submit-btn, corp-dash-tab-*, corp-dash-topup-btn, corp-dash-create-invite-btn, corp-dash-view-landing-btn).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found. All 61 guards pass; public surface correctly hides sensitive fields; role gating enforced; double-enrollment blocked; negative top-up rejected; ledger written.
